article.hook: You hesitate just before hitting send. The urge to push hard meets the need to keep peace. Mars in Libra forces a pause between impulse and action, asking what you’re really fighting for.
article.lived: For the next six weeks, tension lives in the space between words and moves. You’ll rearrange your schedule to avoid a direct clash or draft messages three times before sending. Mars in Libra turns drive into a negotiation, where every step forward counts but waits for a nod. The fight is never solo - it’s a dance with who’s watching or standing next to you.
article.turn: That pause can stretch into silence until frustration sets in. You say yes to keep the peace, then replay the argument alone. The fight doesn’t disappear - it lodges under your skin. Stop editing your anger into politeness and say what you mean before it becomes resentment.
